common.rating_editions: All opened 2026-11-14. (C) current global and US pages: PG 13 MW 12.9 MW(e), 35.00 %, 10,294 kJ/kWh, PR 17.1, 40.0 kg/s, 555 C; PG 15 MW 14.3 MW(e), 35.6 %, 10,103, PR 19.5, 44.5, 529; MD 13 MW 13.4 MW, 36.4 %, 9,886, PR 17.1, 39.1, 543; MD 15 MW 14.9 MW, 37.0 %, 9,702, PR 19.5, 44.5, 529. (B) portfolio PDF Jan 2026 (linked from the page) and BR page: same power, heat rate, flow, temperature; PR in the portfolio is self-contradictory - PG metric 16.9/18.5, PG imperial 17.1/19.5, MD metric 17.1/19.5, MD imperial 16.9/18.5; BR page 16.9/18.5; MD 15 MW efficiency 37.0 % (MD metric) vs 37.1 % (MD imperial; data-sheet range '36.4 - 37.1%'). (A) SGT-400 poster (PDF of 2021, still linked from the page) and CN page: PG 13 MW 12.9 MW, 34.8 %, 10,354, PR 16.9, 40.0, 555; PG 15 MW as C but PR 18.5; MD 13 MW 13.8 MW (18,544 hp), 36.8 %, 9,790, PR 16.9, 40.6 kg/s, 543 C; MD 15 MW 14.9 MW (20,024 hp), 37.1 %, 9,702, PR 18.5, 44.5, 529. Rule: edition C (current manufacturer page) for power, heat rate, flow, temperature and PR; package from the same page (Siemens publishes no package specification). The prelim record noted US-page PR 16.9/18.5; on 2026-11-14 the US page prints 17.1/19.5 like the global page.
common.rating_basis: 'All simple cycle and mechanical drive performance data in this document are gross values at ISO ambient conditions.' (portfolio p. 3); conditions not printed on the page. PG power = gross at generator terminals, MD power = power-turbine shaft. Third party Centrax CX400 (same engine): ISO 15 C, 0 m, 1013 mbar, 60 % RH, natural gas LHV 47889 kJ/kg, '* Inlet losses, exhaust losses & package auxiliary losses are excluded'.
common.pkg_basis: 'Dimensions exclude inlet filter housing and exhaust stack. For power generation, the AC generator is included. For mechanical drive, the driven equipment is excluded.' (page). 'Approx. weight'; enclosure and oil content not stated. PG and MD packages are each common to the 13 and 15 MW versions.
common.pkg_check: Unit pairs on the page consistent: 184,800 lb = 83,824 kg; 88,000 lb = 39,916 kg (rounded 40,000); 46 ft = 14.02 m; 24 ft = 7.32 m; 10 ft = 3.05 m; 14 ft = 4.27 m. Same figures on US, CN, BR pages; CN prints widths '3.1 米（9.4 英尺）' (PG) and '3.1 米（9.0 英尺）' (MD) - 9.4 ft = 2.87 m, 9.0 ft = 2.74 m; metric 3.1 m kept. Centrax CX400 drawing (11,877 / 9,932 / 8,093 mm, 'Approx total weight = 117000 KG') includes enclosure and air intake - other basis, not used. An 11 MW MD package (6.9 x 2.9 x 3.5 m, 30,409 kg) is on CN/BR pages - outside this task.
common.fuel_gas: Supply pressure not published (Siemens page, poster, portfolio; Centrax). Published: 'Fuel* | Natural gas, liquid fuel, dual fuel', '*Other fuels on request'; 'covering a Wobbe fuel range from approximately 50 MJ/m3 to 17.5 MJ/m3'; 'hydrogen (H2) capability of up to 30 vol% with DLE burners or up to 65% with diffusion burners with unabated NOx emissions' (page; CN and BR pages still say 10 vol% with DLE).
common.combustor: 'robust can-annular combustion system with six reverse-flow tubular chambers and a high energy igniter in each combustor' (page); Centrax: '6 reverse flow combustion chambers (cans)'.
common.fluid_modules: 'fluid system modules, common for all SGT-400 gas turbine packages ... include: Auto drains module, Gas fuel module, Lube oil module, Liquid fuel module (optional)' (page)
common.maintenance: 'Extended 32,000-hour hot gas path service intervals, up from 24,000 hours.' '64,000 hours before first major overhaul, up from 48,000 hours.' (page). Fleet: 'more than 450 units have been sold, collectively achieving over 11.7 million hours of operation' (page; FAQ on the same page: 'over 390 units ... more than 5 million operating hours').
common.interface: Output flange, coupling, mounting feet, inlet/exhaust connections: not published. Centrax package: 'Radial exhaust exit (Left/Right/Vertical)'.
common.code_note: Track code not changed here: routes/gtu/gtu_study.py calibrates 'SGT-400 13 MW, mechanical drive' on PR 16.8, 39.4 kg/s, 13.4 MW, 36.2 %; routes/gtu/gtu_dropin.py SLOT S400 uses P 13.4, G 39.4, EGT 555, eta 36.2 - older-datasheet figures that mix MD power with the PG exhaust temperature. Current MD 13 MW: 13.4 MW, 36.4 %, 39.1 kg/s, 543 C, PR 17.1.

Power = free power turbine shaft, gross ISO. Older edition (poster 2021, CN page): 13.8 MW, 36.8 %, 9,790 kJ/kWh, PR 16.9, 40.6 kg/s, 543 °C. Package 7.3 x 3.1 x 4.3 m, 40,000 kg excl. driven equipment, inlet filter house and exhaust stack (common for 13 and 15 MW). Starter and lube figures not published for the Siemens MD package. See common.code_note.

records.shafts: two (twin-shaft: gas generator + free power turbine)
records.out_rpm: 9500 rpm nominal power-turbine (drive shaft) speed; range 4750 - 9975 rpm ('4,750 - 9,500 – 9,975 rpm')
records.turb_stages: 2 CT + 2 PT (two-stage overhung compressor turbine + two-stage overhung free power turbine)

variable_geometry.text: Siemens: 'Variable guide vanes optimize performance' - no row count. Third party Centrax: '11 Stage axial compressor with variable guide vanes on stages 1 to 5' - whether the IGV row is counted inside 'stages 1 to 5' is not stated, so the row count is null (4 or 5).

bleed_valves.text: Third party Centrax: 'blow-off valves to prevent compressor surge' (plural, number not stated). Siemens: not published.

extra.accessory_gearbox_note: Not published. Centrax: 'Gearbox driven main lube oil pump', 'AC driven auxiliary pump', 'DC driven emergency pump' - which gearbox is not stated.

bearings.type: tilting pad journal and thrust (third party Centrax)
bearings.count: gas generator rotor: 2 (Siemens); power turbine: not published
bearings.text: Siemens: 'two-bearing gas generator rotor', compressor turbine and power turbine 'overhung'. Centrax: 'Tilting pad journal & thrust bearings'.

extra.power_take_off: Hot end (exhaust end) drive - third party Centrax: 'Power take-off through exhaust end (hot end drive)'. Not stated by Siemens.
extra.engine_removal: Siemens: 'Easy core engine exchange'; 'Core engine maintenance can be performed on-site or off-site'; 'Heavy-duty casings, horizontally and vertically split, enable on-site maintenance'; 'First-stage rotor blades can be axially removed' (page). 'The 15MW core engine can be retrofitted into existing 13MW package as it retains common interfaces. (service exchange)' (power-upgrade page and PDF). Centrax package: 'Integral engine and auxiliary maintenance beams', 'Each baseplate designed for single point lift'. Removal direction, lift weight, clearances and change-out time not published.
extra.inlet_exhaust_dp_note: Siemens: 'gross values at ISO ambient conditions' - losses not stated. Centrax rating of the same engine excludes inlet and exhaust losses. No nominal dp published.
extra.see_common: rating_editions, rating_basis, pkg_basis, pkg_check, fuel_gas, combustor, fluid_modules, maintenance, interface, code_note
extra.power_at: power-turbine shaft, gross ISO ('Power output | 13.4 MW | 14.9 MW')
extra.gearbox: 'Can be used as direct drive for compressors or pumps' (page); 'gearbox (if needed)'.
extra.out_rpm_range: 4750 - 9500 - 9975 rpm (min - nominal - max); page text 'output speeds up to 10,000 rpm'
extra.starter_note: Not published for the Siemens MD package (Centrax packages generator sets only).
extra.lube_note: Siemens: 'Lube oil module' only - no tank, flow or heat rejection.

conflicts.why: printed by the current page; 0.11 p.p. from 3600/HR (inside the 0.15 p.p. tolerance) - use 37.1 % when consistency with the heat rate matters

extra.check: Second document: power, heat rate, speed range, flow, temperature identical in page, US page, portfolio, poster (20,024 hp = 14,932 kW), CN and BR pages. Internal: 3600/9,702 = 37.11 % vs 37.0 % printed; 9,702 kJ/kWh = 6,857 Btu/hph (the page's 'Btu/kWh' label is wrong); 98.1 lb/s = 44.50 kg/s. Energy balance q = 0.99. Exhaust identical to PG 15 MW - consistent with gearbox and generator losses.
